landmarks.name: Pyramids of Giza
landmarks.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the ancient world, featuring the Great Sphinx and colossal tombs of Pharaohs that showcase humanity's greatest architectural achievements.

landmarks.name: The Egyptian Museum
landmarks.description: Home to an extensive and dazzling collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities, including the legendary golden death mask of King Tutankhamun.

landmarks.name: Karnak Temple
landmarks.description: A vast, ancient temple complex filled with towering pillars, massive obelisks, and intricate hieroglyphics dedicated to the Theban gods.

landmarks.name: Valley of the Kings
landmarks.description: A hidden desert valley containing the rock-cut tombs of ancient pharaohs, designed to protect their mummies and royal treasures for eternity.

landmarks.name: Philae Temple
landmarks.description: A beautiful and romantic island temple dedicated to the goddess Isis, famously relocated block by block to save it from the rising waters of the Nile.

landmarks.name: Abu Simbel Temples
landmarks.description: Two massive rock-cut temples built by Ramses II, famous for their phenomenal solar alignment that illuminates the inner sanctuary twice a year.

landmarks.name: Qaitbay Citadel
landmarks.description: A 15th-century defensive fortress built on the exact site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria, offering stunning panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.

landmarks.name: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
landmarks.description: A striking modern architectural masterpiece and cultural center reviving the legacy of the ancient Library of Alexandria.

landmarks.name: Ras Mohammed National Park
landmarks.description: A stunning marine reserve where the Gulf of Suez meets the Gulf of Aqaba, offering some of the world's most spectacular scuba diving and vibrant coral reefs.

landmarks.name: Soho Square
landmarks.description: A vibrant and upscale entertainment hub featuring a dancing fountain, an ice skating rink, and a variety of international dining options.

landmarks.name: Masjid al-Haram
landmarks.description: The holiest site in Islam, surrounding the sacred Kaaba, where millions of Muslims gather annually for the Hajj pilgrimage.

landmarks.name: Abraj Al Bait (Clock Towers)
landmarks.description: A towering luxury hotel complex featuring the world's largest clock face, majestic architecture, and overlooking the Grand Mosque.

landmarks.name: Al-Masjid an-Nabawi
landmarks.description: The Prophet's Mosque, the second holiest site in Islam, beautifully housing the tomb of Prophet Muhammad under the iconic Green Dome.

landmarks.name: Quba Mosque
landmarks.description: Historically the first mosque ever built in Islam, holding immense spiritual significance and characterized by its elegant white domes.

landmarks.name: Kingdom Centre Tower
landmarks.description: An iconic modern skyscraper featuring a spectacular suspended Sky Bridge that offers unparalleled panoramic views of the bustling capital.

landmarks.name: Al Masmak Fortress
landmarks.description: A historic mud-brick fort that played a crucial role in the unification of Saudi Arabia, now serving as a fascinating museum.

landmarks.name: Al-Balad (Historic Jeddah)
landmarks.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site known for its ancient coral-stone buildings adorned with beautiful wooden balconies called 'Roshan'.

landmarks.name: King Fahd's Fountain
landmarks.description: The highest water fountain in the world, shooting seawater hundreds of meters into the air, illuminated beautifully against the night sky.

landmarks.name: Madain Salih (Hegra)
landmarks.description: Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO site, featuring remarkably preserved Nabataean tombs intricately carved into massive red sandstone outcrops.

landmarks.name: Elephant Rock
landmarks.description: A massive, naturally formed sandstone monolith shaped remarkably like an elephant, serving as a popular and magical desert camping spot.

landmarks.name: Burj Khalifa
landmarks.description: The tallest building in the world, soaring over 828 meters, offering breathtaking above-the-clouds views from its observation decks.

landmarks.name: The Dubai Mall
landmarks.description: A massive, world-class shopping and entertainment destination featuring a giant indoor aquarium, an ice rink, and luxury boutiques.

landmarks.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
landmarks.description: An architectural masterpiece of Islamic art, featuring pure white marble domes, gold-leaf details, and the world's largest hand-woven carpet.

landmarks.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
landmarks.description: A universal art museum with a stunning 'floating' dome design that creates a mesmerizing 'rain of light' effect over its galleries.

landmarks.name: Museum of Islamic Civilization
landmarks.description: A comprehensive museum situated along the waterfront, showcasing thousands of rare artifacts and scientific achievements of Islamic culture.

landmarks.name: Al Noor Island
landmarks.description: A peaceful oasis blending nature and art, featuring a beautifully designed Butterfly House, illuminated pathways, and contemporary sculptures.

landmarks.name: Jebel Jais
landmarks.description: The highest mountain peak in the UAE, offering rugged terrain views and hosting the world's longest zipline for extreme thrill-seekers.

landmarks.name: Dhayah Fort
landmarks.description: An 18th-century hilltop fort offering sweeping views of lush palm gardens and the sea, serving as the last historical line of defense.

landmarks.name: Al Ain Oasis
landmarks.description: A lush, tranquil UNESCO haven filled with thousands of date palms, utilizing the ancient 3,000-year-old 'Falaj' irrigation system.

landmarks.name: Jebel Hafeet
landmarks.description: A towering, craggy mountain offering a spectacular winding driving road, panoramic desert views, and natural hot springs at its base.

landmarks.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
landmarks.description: A bustling, vibrant square filled with snake charmers, traditional storytellers, and lively open-air food stalls that awaken at dusk.

landmarks.name: Majorelle Garden
landmarks.description: A stunning botanical garden designed by a French artist, famous for its exotic plants and striking, vibrant cobalt blue accents.

landmarks.name: Fes el Bali
landmarks.description: The world's largest car-free urban area, featuring a fascinating labyrinth of medieval alleys, historic madrasas, and traditional souks.

landmarks.name: Chouara Tannery
landmarks.description: One of the oldest operating tanneries in the world, where leather is manually dyed in a honeycomb of colorful stone vats.

landmarks.name: Hassan II Mosque
landmarks.description: A majestic mosque built partially over the Atlantic Ocean, featuring the world's tallest minaret and intricate Moroccan tilework.

landmarks.name: Morocco Mall
landmarks.description: One of the largest shopping centers in Africa, boasting a massive cylindrical aquarium, luxury shopping, and a musical fountain.

landmarks.name: The Blue Streets
landmarks.description: A picturesque mountain town famous globally for its charming alleys and buildings painted in incredibly striking shades of blue.

landmarks.name: Kasbah Museum
landmarks.description: A beautifully restored 15th-century fortress located in the main square, featuring a peaceful Andalusian garden and regional artifacts.

landmarks.name: Hassan Tower
landmarks.description: The imposing, unfinished minaret of an ambitious 12th-century mosque, surrounded by hundreds of historical marble columns.

landmarks.name: Kasbah of the Udayas
landmarks.description: A fortified historic neighborhood offering scenic ocean views, characterized by its narrow streets and tranquil blue and white walls.

landmarks.name: Eiffel Tower
landmarks.description: The iconic wrought-iron symbol of Paris, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the romantic city and the River Seine.

landmarks.name: Louvre Museum
landmarks.description: The world's largest art museum and a historic monument, home to thousands of masterpieces, including the legendary Mona Lisa.

landmarks.name: Promenade des Anglais
landmarks.description: A stunning waterfront boulevard stretching along the Mediterranean coast, perfect for sunset strolls and enjoying the French Riviera.

landmarks.name: Castle Hill
landmarks.description: A lush park situated on a historic hill, providing the best panoramic views of the Baie des Anges and the city's red rooftops.

landmarks.name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière
landmarks.description: A magnificent white church perched on a hill, featuring intricate mosaics and overlooking the entire city of Lyon.

landmarks.name: Vieux Lyon
landmarks.description: One of Europe's most extensive Renaissance neighborhoods, famous for its hidden, secret passageways known as 'traboules'.

landmarks.name: Old Port of Marseille
landmarks.description: The vibrant historical heart of the city, bustling with fishing boats, luxury yachts, and lively waterfront seafood cafes.

landmarks.name: Notre-Dame de la Garde
landmarks.description: A Neo-Byzantine basilica standing at the highest natural point in Marseille, crowned by a golden statue of the Virgin Mary.

landmarks.name: Place de la Bourse
landmarks.description: A spectacular 18th-century square that reflects elegantly on the Miroir d'eau, the world's largest water reflecting pool.

landmarks.name: La Cité du Vin
landmarks.description: A futuristic, highly interactive museum dedicated to the global history, culture, and creation of wine.

landmarks.name: Colosseum
landmarks.description: An iconic symbol of Imperial Rome, this monumental ancient amphitheater once hosted thrilling gladiator contests and massive public spectacles.

landmarks.name: Vatican Museums
landmarks.description: A vast complex housing some of the world's most important Renaissance art, crowned by Michelangelo's breathtaking ceiling in the Sistine Chapel.

landmarks.name: Grand Canal
landmarks.description: The main waterway of Venice, best explored by a traditional gondola ride passing by stunning centuries-old palaces and romantic bridges.

landmarks.name: St. Mark's Basilica
landmarks.description: An architectural masterpiece dominating St. Mark's Square, famous for its opulent design, golden mosaics, and status as a symbol of Venetian wealth.

landmarks.name: Florence Cathedral (Duomo)
landmarks.description: A magnificent Gothic cathedral featuring Brunelleschi's iconic red-tiled dome, standing as a testament to the brilliance of the Renaissance era.

landmarks.name: Uffizi Gallery
landmarks.description: One of the most famous art museums globally, housing an incomparable collection of priceless masterpieces by artists like Botticelli and Leonardo da Vinci.

landmarks.name: Duomo di Milano
landmarks.description: A breathtakingly vast Gothic cathedral adorned with thousands of marble statues and soaring spires that dominate the city's main square.

landmarks.name: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
landmarks.description: Italy's oldest active shopping mall, housed within a striking four-story double arcade featuring a magnificent glass-vaulted ceiling.

landmarks.name: Mount Vesuvius
landmarks.description: A legendary active volcano towering over the Bay of Naples, famous for its devastating eruption that buried the ancient city of Pompeii.

landmarks.name: Pompeii Archaeological Park
landmarks.description: A vast, frozen-in-time ancient Roman city perfectly preserved under volcanic ash, offering a profound glimpse into daily life in antiquity.

landmarks.name: Big Ben & Parliament
landmarks.description: The iconic clock tower and the spectacular Gothic Revival Palace of Westminster, resting beautifully along the banks of the River Thames.

landmarks.name: Tower of London
landmarks.description: A historic castle founded in 1066, famous for housing the dazzling Crown Jewels and its dark history as a royal prison.

landmarks.name: Edinburgh Castle
landmarks.description: A formidable historic fortress dominating the city's skyline from its position on the Castle Rock, offering sweeping views of the Scottish capital.

landmarks.name: Arthur's Seat
landmarks.description: An ancient volcano sitting majestically right next to the city center, providing excellent hiking trails and panoramic views of Edinburgh.

landmarks.name: Old Trafford Stadium
landmarks.description: Known as 'The Theatre of Dreams,' this historic and massive stadium is the beloved home ground of Manchester United Football Club.

landmarks.name: John Rylands Library
landmarks.description: A stunning masterpiece of Victorian Gothic architecture housing a remarkable collection of rare books and ancient manuscripts.

landmarks.name: The Roman Baths
landmarks.description: An exceptionally well-preserved ancient Roman public bathing complex built over natural hot springs, offering a fascinating journey into the past.

landmarks.name: Royal Crescent
landmarks.description: A sweeping, majestic crescent of 30 terraced houses laid out in a massive arc, representing the pinnacle of Georgian Palladian architecture.

landmarks.name: York Minster
landmarks.description: One of the largest and most magnificent cathedrals in Northern Europe, renowned for its incredible medieval stained glass windows.

landmarks.name: The Shambles
landmarks.description: A wonderfully preserved medieval street with overhanging timber-framed buildings that famously inspired Diagon Alley in Harry Potter.

landmarks.name: Prado Museum
landmarks.description: A world-class national art museum featuring an expansive and prestigious collection of European art, including masterworks by Velázquez and Goya.

landmarks.name: Royal Palace of Madrid
landmarks.description: The lavish and sprawling official residence of the Spanish royal family, boasting over 3,000 ornately decorated rooms and grand armories.

landmarks.name: Sagrada Familia
landmarks.description: Antoni Gaudí's unfinished architectural marvel, a colossal basilica blending Gothic and Art Nouveau forms with stunning, forest-like interiors.

landmarks.name: Park Güell
landmarks.description: A vibrant, whimsical public park system designed by Gaudí, famous for its colorful mosaic salamander and panoramic views of Barcelona.

landmarks.name: Plaza de España
landmarks.description: A breathtakingly beautiful semi-circular brick building featuring Renaissance Revival architecture, tiled alcoves, and a romantic canal.

landmarks.name: Royal Alcázar of Seville
landmarks.description: A spectacular royal palace originally developed by Moorish Muslim kings, renowned for its exquisite Mudéjar architecture and lush, tranquil gardens.

landmarks.name: Alhambra Palace
landmarks.description: An astonishing palace and fortress complex showcasing the pinnacle of Moorish art and architecture against the backdrop of the Sierra Nevada mountains.

landmarks.name: Generalife Gardens
landmarks.description: The elegant summer palace and country estate of the Nasrid rulers, featuring beautifully manicured gardens, serene courtyards, and flowing water features.

landmarks.name: City of Arts and Sciences
landmarks.description: A futuristic and visually stunning scientific and cultural complex boasting an opera house, science museum, and the largest aquarium in Europe.

landmarks.name: La Lonja de la Seda
landmarks.description: A masterpiece of late Gothic architecture, this 15th-century silk exchange building vividly illustrates the immense wealth of Valencia's golden age.

landmarks.name: Hagia Sophia
landmarks.description: A monumental architectural marvel that served as a patriarchal cathedral, an imperial mosque, and a museum, symbolizing the rich history of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires.

landmarks.name: The Blue Mosque
landmarks.description: An iconic historical mosque famous for its six towering minarets and the magnificent, hand-painted blue tiles adorning its interior walls.

landmarks.name: Göreme National Park
landmarks.description: A magical, otherworldly landscape famous for its 'fairy chimney' rock formations and the unforgettable experience of sunrise hot air balloon rides.

landmarks.name: Derinkuyu Underground City
landmarks.description: An ancient, multi-level underground city extending deep below the earth, used historically by thousands of people to hide during times of war.

landmarks.name: Düden Waterfalls
landmarks.description: A spectacular set of waterfalls where the lower falls plunge dramatically off a rocky cliff directly into the pristine waters of the Mediterranean Sea.

landmarks.name: Hadrian's Gate
landmarks.description: A beautifully preserved triumphal arch built in the name of the Roman Emperor Hadrian, featuring three magnificent arched gates and ornate floral motifs.

landmarks.name: Ephesus Ancient City
landmarks.description: One of the greatest ruined cities in the western world, featuring the awe-inspiring Library of Celsus and a massive ancient amphitheater.

landmarks.name: Kemeralti Market
landmarks.description: A vibrant, historic bazaar district dating back to the 17th century, filled with colorful spices, traditional Turkish coffee houses, and artisan crafts.

landmarks.name: Bodrum Castle
landmarks.description: A majestic fortress built by the Knights Hospitaller in the 15th century, now housing a fascinating museum dedicated to underwater archaeology.

landmarks.name: Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
landmarks.description: The ruins of an ancient tomb built for Mausolus, renowned in antiquity as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

landmarks.name: Senso-ji Temple
landmarks.description: Tokyo's oldest and most significant Buddhist temple, famous for its giant red lantern and the vibrant Nakamise shopping street leading to its main hall.

landmarks.name: Tokyo Skytree
landmarks.description: A staggering neo-futuristic broadcasting tower that stands as the tallest structure in Japan, offering unmatched, sprawling views of the metropolis.

landmarks.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
landmarks.description: A deeply spiritual and iconic Shinto shrine famous for its thousands of vibrant vermilion torii gates winding through a dense, wooded forest.

landmarks.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
landmarks.description: A breathtaking Zen Buddhist temple whose top two floors are completely covered in gold leaf, reflecting perfectly in the serene pond before it.

landmarks.name: Osaka Castle
landmarks.description: A spectacular historical castle surrounded by impressive stone walls and moats, standing as a beautiful symbol of power and history amidst the modern city.

landmarks.name: Dotonbori
landmarks.description: The glowing, neon-lit heart of Osaka, famous for its incredible street food culture, vibrant nightlife, and the iconic Glico Man billboard.

landmarks.name: Peace Memorial Park
landmarks.description: A moving and somber memorial park dedicated to the victims of the atomic bomb, featuring the haunting ruins of the Atomic Bomb Dome.

landmarks.name: Itsukushima Shrine (Miyajima)
landmarks.description: A deeply revered Shinto shrine globally famous for its unique 'floating' torii gate that appears to stand on the water during high tide.

landmarks.name: Todai-ji Temple
landmarks.description: A colossal wooden temple complex that houses Japan's largest bronze statue of Buddha, representing a major achievement in ancient architecture.

landmarks.name: Nara Park
landmarks.description: A sprawling public park famous for being home to hundreds of freely roaming, semi-tame sika deer considered to be sacred messengers of the gods.

landmarks.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
landmarks.description: A peaceful and highly scenic lake in the historical center of the city, featuring the iconic red Huc Bridge and the Turtle Tower.

landmarks.name: Temple of Literature
landmarks.description: A stunning, exceptionally well-preserved traditional temple complex dedicated to Confucius, serving as Vietnam's first national university.

landmarks.name: Cu Chi Tunnels
landmarks.description: An immense network of connecting underground tunnels used extensively by Viet Cong soldiers during the Vietnam War.

landmarks.name: War Remnants Museum
landmarks.description: A deeply moving and powerful museum containing profound exhibits relating to the First Indochina War and the Vietnam War.

landmarks.name: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
landmarks.description: A spectacular mountain resort featuring a breathtaking pedestrian bridge seemingly held aloft by two giant, moss-covered stone hands.

landmarks.name: Dragon Bridge
landmarks.description: An incredible modern bridge over the Han River, shaped like a golden dragon that actually breathes fire and water on weekends.

landmarks.name: Hoi An Ancient Town
landmarks.description: A remarkably well-preserved Southeast Asian trading port illuminated by thousands of colorful silk lanterns at night.

landmarks.name: Japanese Covered Bridge
landmarks.description: A beautiful 18th-century wooden bridge featuring intricate carvings and a small temple, serving as the historical emblem of the city.

landmarks.name: Ha Long Bay
landmarks.description: A mesmerizing UNESCO World Heritage site known for its emerald waters and thousands of towering limestone islands topped by rainforests.

landmarks.name: Ti Top Island
landmarks.description: A small but stunning island in the bay offering a crescent-shaped beach and a strenuous climb to a spectacular panoramic viewpoint.

landmarks.name: Uluwatu Temple
landmarks.description: A magnificent Balinese sea temple perched on the edge of a steep cliff, famous for its dramatic ocean views and traditional fire dances.

landmarks.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
landmarks.description: A lush, mystical nature reserve and temple complex heavily populated by hundreds of playful, free-roaming long-tailed macaques.

landmarks.name: National Monument (Monas)
landmarks.description: A massive obelisk in the center of Merdeka Square, topped with a flame coated in gold foil, symbolizing the fight for Indonesian independence.

landmarks.name: Istiqlal Mosque
landmarks.description: The largest mosque in Southeast Asia, featuring a massive central dome and serving as a striking symbol of the nation's religious harmony.

landmarks.name: Borobudur Temple
landmarks.description: The world's largest Buddhist temple, an awe-inspiring 9th-century monument decorated with thousands of intricate relief panels and Buddha statues.

landmarks.name: Prambanan Temple
landmarks.description: A magnificent 9th-century Hindu temple complex renowned for its tall, pointed architecture and elaborate carvings telling the epic Ramayana story.

landmarks.name: Tangkuban Perahu
landmarks.description: An active, easily accessible stratovolcano where visitors can hike right up to the edge of its bubbling, sulfur-emitting crater.

landmarks.name: Kawah Putih
landmarks.description: A surreal and highly photogenic volcanic crater lake known for its striking, pale turquoise waters and dramatic white landscape.

landmarks.name: Mount Bromo
landmarks.description: An iconic, active volcano set inside a vast caldera, famous for its otherworldly landscape and spectacular, breathtaking sunrise views.

landmarks.name: House of Sampoerna
landmarks.description: A fascinating clove cigarette museum housed in a beautiful Dutch colonial building, offering a glimpse into Indonesia's unique tobacco history.

landmarks.name: Petronas Twin Towers
landmarks.description: Stunningly massive twin skyscrapers representing modern Malaysia, featuring an iconic double-decker skybridge connecting the two structures.

landmarks.name: Batu Caves
landmarks.description: A massive limestone hill comprising a series of caves and Hindu temples, guarded by a colossal golden statue of Lord Murugan.

landmarks.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
landmarks.description: One of the largest and most beautifully intricately designed Buddhist temples in Southeast Asia, overlooking the city from a hilltop.

landmarks.name: Penang Hill
landmarks.description: A lush, forested peak offering a cooling retreat and spectacular panoramic views of the island, accessible via a historic funicular railway.

landmarks.name: Langkawi Sky Bridge
landmarks.description: A spectacular curved pedestrian bridge suspended high above the jungle canopy, offering terrifyingly beautiful views of the Andaman Sea.

landmarks.name: Kilim Karst Geoforest Park
landmarks.description: A stunning nature reserve featuring majestic limestone cliffs, hidden caves, and winding mangrove rivers explorable by boat.

landmarks.name: A Famosa Fort
landmarks.description: The historical remains of a 16th-century Portuguese fortress, representing one of the oldest surviving European architectural remains in Asia.

landmarks.name: Jonker Street Night Market
landmarks.description: A vibrant, bustling weekend market street famous for its incredible array of local street food, antique shops, and lively atmosphere.

landmarks.name: Mount Kinabalu
landmarks.description: The highest mountain in Malaysia, renowned globally for its incredible biodiversity and challenging but rewarding hiking trails.

landmarks.name: Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park
landmarks.description: A cluster of five stunning tropical islands located just off the coast, perfect for island-hopping, snorkeling, and pristine beaches.

landmarks.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
landmarks.description: The largest and most striking of the Five Grand Palaces built during the Joseon Dynasty, featuring grand gates and beautiful traditional gardens.

landmarks.name: N Seoul Tower
landmarks.description: An iconic communication and observation tower located on Namsan Mountain, offering unparalleled 360-degree views of the sprawling city.

landmarks.name: Haeundae Beach
landmarks.description: South Korea's most famous and beloved white-sand beach, surrounded by luxury hotels, bustling boardwalks, and lively seasonal festivals.

landmarks.name: Gamcheon Culture Village
landmarks.description: A steeply terraced, incredibly colorful village known as the 'Machu Picchu of Busan,' filled with vibrant murals and winding alleys.

landmarks.name: Hallasan Mountain
landmarks.description: A massive dormant volcano standing as the highest mountain in South Korea, offering scenic hiking trails through a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.

landmarks.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong
landmarks.description: A dramatic, bowl-like volcanic crater rising from the sea, famous for offering the absolute best sunrise views on Jeju Island.

landmarks.name: Bulguksa Temple
landmarks.description: A masterful, highly celebrated Buddhist temple complex dating back to the 8th century, representing the golden age of Buddhist art in the Silla kingdom.

landmarks.name: Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond
landmarks.description: A beautiful historical palace complex featuring traditional pavilions reflecting perfectly in a serene artificial pond, incredibly stunning when illuminated at night.

landmarks.name: Incheon Chinatown
landmarks.description: South Korea's only official Chinatown, featuring highly ornate gates, vibrant red lanterns, and the birthplace of the famous Jajangmyeon noodle dish.

landmarks.name: Songdo Central Park
landmarks.description: A spectacular, massive green oasis situated in the middle of a futuristic smart city, featuring a seawater canal perfect for boating.

landmarks.name: Marina Bay Sands
landmarks.description: An architectural marvel featuring three towering hotel blocks topped with a massive, ship-like sky park and a jaw-dropping infinity pool.

landmarks.name: Gardens by the Bay
landmarks.description: A futuristic nature park famous for its massive, otherworldly Supertrees and massive climate-controlled bio-domes.

landmarks.name: Universal Studios Singapore
landmarks.description: A world-class theme park featuring highly immersive zones, thrilling roller coasters, and attractions based on blockbuster movies.

landmarks.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
landmarks.description: One of the largest aquariums in the world, home to thousands of marine animals viewed through spectacular, massive glass panels.

landmarks.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
landmarks.description: A stunningly ornate, multi-story Buddhist temple built in a traditional Tang dynasty style, famously housing a sacred relic of the Buddha.

landmarks.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
landmarks.description: Singapore's oldest Hindu temple, featuring a spectacularly colorful and towering gopuram (entrance tower) adorned with intricate deity sculptures.

landmarks.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
landmarks.description: A vibrant and historically rich Hindu temple dedicated to the goddess Kali, deeply intertwined with the history of early Indian pioneers in Singapore.

landmarks.name: Mustafa Centre
landmarks.description: A legendary, massive 24-hour shopping mall that sells absolutely everything under the sun, from electronics to exotic spices.

landmarks.name: Orchard Road
landmarks.description: Asia's most famous shopping street, featuring miles of glittering, ultra-modern shopping malls, luxury boutiques, and endless dining options.

landmarks.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
landmarks.description: A 160-year-old tropical garden and UNESCO World Heritage site, famous for its sprawling lawns and the stunning National Orchid Garden.

landmarks.name: The Grand Palace
landmarks.description: A spectacular and dazzling complex of buildings at the heart of the city, serving as the official residence of the Kings of Siam since 1782.

landmarks.name: Wat Arun
landmarks.description: Known as the Temple of Dawn, this stunning riverside temple features a towering spire beautifully decorated with colorful porcelain.

landmarks.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
landmarks.description: A deeply sacred and visually stunning golden temple perched on a mountain, offering panoramic views of the city below.

landmarks.name: Elephant Nature Park
landmarks.description: A highly respected rescue and rehabilitation center where visitors can ethically interact with and observe majestic elephants in a natural environment.

landmarks.name: Patong Beach
landmarks.description: Thailand's most famous and lively beach resort town, renowned for its extensive sandy shores, water sports, and incredibly vibrant nightlife.

landmarks.name: Big Buddha
landmarks.description: A colossal, 45-meter-tall white marble statue seated at the top of the Nakkerd Hills, offering sweeping 360-degree views of the island.

landmarks.name: Sanctuary of Truth
landmarks.description: A gigantic, awe-inspiring wooden structure entirely carved by hand, blending elements of a temple and a palace to honor ancient philosophy.

landmarks.name: Walking Street
landmarks.description: A world-famous, neon-lit street that comes alive at night, completely closed to vehicles and packed with entertainment venues and seafood restaurants.

landmarks.name: Ayutthaya Historical Park
landmarks.description: A fascinating UNESCO World Heritage site featuring the expansive ruins of the second capital of the Siamese Kingdom, filled with ancient temples and statues.

landmarks.name: Wat Mahathat
landmarks.description: An iconic historical temple famous for the captivating stone Buddha head beautifully intertwined within the roots of a massive banyan tree.

landmarks.name: Table Mountain
landmarks.description: A spectacular flat-topped mountain providing a dramatic backdrop to the city, accessible by a scenic cableway offering breathtaking coastal views.

landmarks.name: Cape of Good Hope
landmarks.description: A rugged, incredibly scenic rocky headland on the Atlantic coast, famous for its dramatic cliffs, turbulent waters, and rich maritime history.

landmarks.name: Apartheid Museum
landmarks.description: A profoundly moving and essential museum detailing the 20th-century history of South Africa and its monumental struggle against apartheid.

landmarks.name: Constitution Hill
landmarks.description: A former prison and military fort that now serves as a powerful museum and the inspiring home of the country's Constitutional Court.

landmarks.name: Golden Mile
landmarks.description: A popular, sun-drenched stretch of beachfront famous for its golden sands, excellent surfing spots, and vibrant promenades.

landmarks.name: uShaka Marine World
landmarks.description: A massive, world-class marine theme park and aquarium designed around a series of shipwreck-themed venues.

landmarks.name: Union Buildings
landmarks.description: The majestic official seat of the South African government, featuring striking sandstone architecture and beautifully terraced gardens.

landmarks.name: Voortrekker Monument
landmarks.description: A massive granite monument situated on a hilltop, honoring the pioneer history of the Afrikaners who migrated into the interior.

landmarks.name: Cape Winelands
landmarks.description: A breathtakingly beautiful region characterized by rolling vineyards, towering mountains, and historic Cape Dutch architecture, famous for world-class wine tasting.

landmarks.name: Jonkershoek Nature Reserve
landmarks.description: A stunning, mountainous nature reserve featuring deep valleys, cascading waterfalls, and excellent trails for hiking and mountain biking.

landmarks.name: Nairobi National Park
landmarks.description: A unique wildlife park situated right on the edge of the city, offering the incredible sight of wild lions and giraffes against a backdrop of city skyscrapers.

landmarks.name: David Sheldrick Wildlife Trust
landmarks.description: A world-renowned orphan-elephant rescue and rehabilitation program where visitors can watch adorable baby elephants being fed and playing.

landmarks.name: Fort Jesus
landmarks.description: A massive 16th-century fortress built by the Portuguese, featuring impressive, well-preserved architecture that tells the story of the Indian Ocean trade.

landmarks.name: Diani Beach
landmarks.description: Consistently voted one of Africa's best beaches, known for its flawless white sands, crystal-clear waters, and lush palm trees.

landmarks.name: Lake Nakuru National Park
landmarks.description: A stunning wildlife park built around a shallow lake, globally famous for attracting massive, vibrant flocks of pink flamingos and protecting rhinos.

landmarks.name: Menengai Crater
landmarks.description: One of the largest volcanic calderas in the world, offering spectacular panoramic views of the Great Rift Valley from its rim.

landmarks.name: Lake Victoria
landmarks.description: The largest tropical lake in the world, offering serene boat rides, excellent bird watching, and spectacular sunsets over the water.

landmarks.name: Kisumu Impala Sanctuary
landmarks.description: A peaceful lakeside sanctuary providing a safe haven for herds of impalas, hippos, and various rescued wildlife species.

landmarks.name: Watamu Marine National Park
landmarks.description: A spectacular underwater park boasting vibrant coral gardens and rich marine life, making it a paradise for snorkeling and scuba diving.

landmarks.name: Malindi Museum
landmarks.description: Housed in a charming historic building, this museum exhibits the fascinating history and culture of the Swahili coastal people.

landmarks.name: The Medina of Tunis
landmarks.description: A sprawling, vibrant UNESCO-listed old town featuring a maze of narrow alleyways, bustling souks, and magnificent ancient palaces.

landmarks.name: Bardo National Museum
landmarks.description: One of the most important museums in the Mediterranean, housing the world's largest and most breathtaking collection of ancient Roman mosaics.

landmarks.name: Ribat of Sousse
landmarks.description: An imposing 8th-century Islamic defensive fortress featuring a tall watchtower that offers fantastic views over the Medina and the sea.

landmarks.name: Port El Kantaoui
landmarks.description: A picturesque, upscale tourist complex centered around a beautiful marina full of luxury yachts, cobblestone streets, and charming cafes.

landmarks.name: Hammamet Beach
landmarks.description: A stunning stretch of golden sand lined with palm trees, offering a perfect, sun-drenched Mediterranean retreat for swimming and relaxing.

landmarks.name: Yasmine Hammamet
landmarks.description: A beautifully designed modern tourist resort area featuring a bustling marina, a medina replica, and a vibrant theme park.

landmarks.name: El Ghriba Synagogue
landmarks.description: The oldest synagogue in Africa, featuring stunning blue tiles and intricate woodwork, serving as a site of annual pilgrimage.

landmarks.name: Djerbahood
landmarks.description: An open-air museum in a traditional village where hundreds of artists from around the world have transformed the walls into breathtaking street art.

landmarks.name: Sahara Desert Oasis
landmarks.description: A surprisingly lush and expansive palm grove oasis rising dramatically from the arid desert, famously watered by hundreds of natural springs.

landmarks.name: Mos Espa (Star Wars Set)
landmarks.description: The incredibly well-preserved, surreal movie sets built directly in the desert dunes, used to film the iconic Tatooine scenes in Star Wars.

landmarks.name: Souq Waqif
landmarks.description: A vibrant, beautifully restored traditional market bustling with energy, offering everything from fragrant spices and traditional garments to falconry shops.

landmarks.name: Museum of Islamic Art
landmarks.description: An architectural masterpiece resting on its own artificial island, housing one of the world's most comprehensive collections of Islamic artifacts.

landmarks.name: Katara Towers
landmarks.description: An iconic, crescent-shaped architectural marvel that dominates the skyline, designed to represent the traditional scimitar swords of Qatar.

landmarks.name: Lusail Boulevard
landmarks.description: A futuristic, pedestrian-friendly avenue filled with dynamic light displays, high-end shopping, and cutting-edge modern architecture.

landmarks.name: Al Wakrah Souq
landmarks.description: A charming, traditional market situated right on the beach, featuring historical architecture, narrow alleyways, and excellent seaside dining.

landmarks.name: Al Wakrah Public Beach
landmarks.description: A peaceful, family-friendly beach featuring soft sands, shallow waters, and designated areas for barbecuing and relaxing by the sea.

landmarks.name: Al Bayt Stadium
landmarks.description: A spectacular, massive stadium designed to look like a traditional Bedouin tent, famously hosting the opening match of the 2022 World Cup.

landmarks.name: Al Khor Park
landmarks.description: One of the oldest and largest parks in Qatar, featuring a well-maintained zoo, expansive green spaces, and family entertainment areas.

landmarks.name: Al Zubarah Fort
landmarks.description: A meticulously restored, quintessential Arab fort standing in the desert, guarding the ruins of a once-thriving pearl fishing and trading port.

landmarks.name: Ruwayda
landmarks.description: One of the largest archaeological sites in Qatar, revealing the fascinating foundations of a historically significant coastal town and fortress.

landmarks.name: Statue of Liberty
landmarks.description: A colossal neoclassical copper sculpture on Liberty Island, serving as a universal symbol of freedom and democracy for millions of immigrants.

landmarks.name: Central Park
landmarks.description: An immense, beautifully landscaped green oasis in the middle of Manhattan, featuring lakes, theaters, ice rinks, and scenic walking trails.

landmarks.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
landmarks.description: A legendary sidewalk embedded with thousands of brass stars, honoring the greatest achievements of the entertainment industry's most famous celebrities.

landmarks.name: Griffith Observatory
landmarks.description: An iconic facility perched high on Mount Hollywood, offering fascinating cosmos exhibits and unmatched, sweeping views of the LA basin and the Hollywood Sign.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.description: An internationally recognized suspension bridge painted in a striking 'International Orange', gracefully connecting the city to Marin County over the strait.

landmarks.name: Alcatraz Island
landmarks.description: A notorious, isolated island in the bay that once housed America's most dangerous criminals in an inescapable federal penitentiary.

landmarks.name: The Las Vegas Strip
landmarks.description: A dazzling, neon-soaked boulevard world-renowned for its massive, elaborately themed resort hotels, 24-hour casinos, and spectacular shows.

landmarks.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Garden
landmarks.description: An awe-inspiring indoor garden within a luxury resort, featuring incredibly elaborate, seasonal floral displays meticulously crafted by horticulturists.

landmarks.name: Cloud Gate (The Bean)
landmarks.description: A massive, seamless stainless-steel sculpture in Millennium Park that brilliantly reflects and distorts the city's famous skyline.

landmarks.name: Navy Pier
landmarks.description: A lively, 3,300-foot-long pier on the shoreline of Lake Michigan, packed with family attractions, a giant Ferris wheel, and diverse restaurants.

landmarks.name: CN Tower
landmarks.description: An iconic, 553-meter-high concrete communications and observation tower dominating the downtown skyline, offering thrilling glass-floor views.

landmarks.name: Royal Ontario Museum
landmarks.description: Canada's largest museum of world culture and natural history, renowned for its striking, crystal-like modern architectural extension.

landmarks.name: Stanley Park
landmarks.description: A magnificent, 400-hectare public park bordering downtown, completely surrounded by waters and famous for its scenic seawall and totem poles.

landmarks.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge
landmarks.description: A thrilling, historic suspension bridge crossing the Capilano River, surrounded by a lush coastal rainforest and spectacular treetop walkways.

landmarks.name: Old Montreal
landmarks.description: A charming, beautifully preserved historic district featuring cobblestone streets, horse-drawn carriages, and stunning European-style architecture.

landmarks.name: Mount Royal
landmarks.description: A massive, lush volcanic hill right in the heart of the city, designed by the same architect as Central Park, offering the best skyline views.

landmarks.name: Château Frontenac
landmarks.description: A grand, castle-like historic hotel that dominates the city's skyline, holding the Guinness World Record as the most photographed hotel in the world.

landmarks.name: Montmorency Falls
landmarks.description: A spectacular, massive waterfall dropping 84 meters—significantly higher than Niagara Falls—featuring a scenic suspension bridge directly over the crest.

landmarks.name: Banff National Park & Lake Louise
landmarks.description: Canada's oldest national park, famous globally for its jaw-dropping, turquoise glacial lakes surrounded by soaring, snow-capped Rocky Mountains.

landmarks.name: Sulphur Mountain
landmarks.description: A stunning mountain accessed by a scenic gondola ride, featuring boardwalk trails and incredibly relaxing, natural hot springs at its base.

landmarks.name: Christ the Redeemer
landmarks.description: A colossal Art Deco statue of Jesus Christ with outstretched arms, standing majestically at the peak of the Corcovado mountain.

landmarks.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
landmarks.description: A dramatic, monolithic granite peak rising straight from the harbor, accessible by glass-walled cable cars that offer stunning sunset views.

landmarks.name: Ibirapuera Park
landmarks.description: A massive, beautifully landscaped urban park that serves as the green lungs of the city, featuring lakes, monuments, and iconic modernist museums.

landmarks.name: Paulista Avenue
landmarks.description: The bustling, beating economic heart of the city, lined with towering skyscrapers, cultural centers, street musicians, and vibrant energy.

landmarks.name: Pelourinho (Historic Center)
landmarks.description: A vibrant UNESCO World Heritage site known for its brightly painted colonial buildings, cobblestone streets, and the rhythmic sounds of Afro-Brazilian drumming.

landmarks.name: Elevador Lacerda
landmarks.description: An iconic, historic Art Deco elevator that rapidly connects the lower and upper parts of the city, offering panoramic views of the stunning Bay of All Saints.

landmarks.name: Iguazu Falls
landmarks.description: One of the most awe-inspiring natural wonders on earth, featuring a chain of hundreds of massive waterfalls thundering through a lush tropical rainforest.

landmarks.name: Parque das Aves
landmarks.description: An internationally recognized bird rescue and conservation park, offering an incredibly immersive experience walking through massive aviaries.

landmarks.name: Amazon Theatre
landmarks.description: A stunning, pink Renaissance-style opera house built during the rubber boom, located incredibly right in the middle of the Amazon rainforest.

landmarks.name: Meeting of Waters
landmarks.description: A fascinating natural phenomenon where the dark, sandy Rio Negro runs side-by-side with the muddy Amazon River without mixing for miles.

landmarks.name: The Obelisco
landmarks.description: A towering, iconic national historic monument and focal point of the city, erected in the exceptionally wide Avenida 9 de Julio.

landmarks.name: La Boca (Caminito)
landmarks.description: A lively, colorful neighborhood renowned for its incredibly vibrant, multi-colored tin houses, street tango dancers, and rich immigrant history.

landmarks.name: Aconcagua Mountain
landmarks.description: The highest mountain in the Americas and the entire Southern Hemisphere, attracting climbers and trekkers to its breathtaking, snow-capped peaks.

landmarks.name: Uco Valley
landmarks.description: A stunningly beautiful wine region set against the dramatic backdrop of the Andes, famous globally for producing world-class Malbec wines.

landmarks.name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
landmarks.description: A spectacular wilderness area at the 'End of the World', featuring dramatic glaciers, deep valleys, and lush subantarctic forests.

landmarks.name: Beagle Channel
landmarks.description: A highly scenic, navigable strait separating islands of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago, offering incredible boat tours to see penguins and sea lions.

landmarks.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
landmarks.description: A massive, expanding glacier that offers visitors the rare and thrilling opportunity to watch huge chunks of ice famously calve and crash into the lake.

landmarks.name: Glaciarium
landmarks.description: A highly modern, striking ice museum dedicated to Patagonian glaciers, featuring interactive exhibits and a bar made entirely of glacial ice.

landmarks.name: Nahuel Huapi Lake
landmarks.description: A vast, crystal-clear glacial lake surrounded by spectacular alpine scenery, offering excellent opportunities for kayaking, fishing, and scenic cruises.

landmarks.name: Cerro Catedral
landmarks.description: The biggest and most developed ski resort in South America, transforming into an incredible hiking and mountain biking destination in the summer.

landmarks.name: Machu Picchu
landmarks.description: The legendary 15th-century Incan citadel situated high on a mountain ridge, representing one of the most spectacular archaeological sites in the world.

landmarks.name: Sacsayhuamán
landmarks.description: An awe-inspiring Inca fortress complex famous for its massive, dry-stone walls constructed with boulders so tightly fitted that not even a piece of paper can pass between them.

landmarks.name: Plaza Mayor
landmarks.description: The historic, majestic heart of the Peruvian capital, surrounded by impressive yellow colonial buildings including the Government Palace and the Cathedral.

landmarks.name: Larco Museum
landmarks.description: A privately owned museum housed in an 18th-century vice-royal building, showcasing a remarkable collection of pre-Columbian art and gold artifacts.

landmarks.name: Santa Catalina Monastery
landmarks.description: A beautifully preserved, brightly painted historical convent that operates almost like a secret city within a city, featuring vibrant courtyards and cloisters.

landmarks.name: Colca Canyon
landmarks.description: One of the deepest canyons in the world—twice as deep as the Grand Canyon—famous for terraced agriculture and being the premier spot to watch majestic Andean condors in flight.

landmarks.name: Lake Titicaca
landmarks.description: The highest navigable lake in the world, considered the sacred birthplace of the Incas, featuring deep blue waters and fascinating indigenous communities.

landmarks.name: Uros Floating Islands
landmarks.description: Incredibly unique, man-made islands constructed entirely from buoyant totora reeds, where the Uros people have lived traditionally for centuries.

landmarks.name: The Amazon River
landmarks.description: The undisputed gateway to the Peruvian Amazon jungle, accessible only by boat or plane, offering unforgettable rainforest expeditions and wildlife viewing.

landmarks.name: Pacaya Samiria National Reserve
landmarks.description: A massive, pristine area of flooded Amazonian forest, renowned for incredible biodiversity including the famous and elusive pink river dolphins.

landmarks.name: Mount Monserrate
landmarks.description: A towering mountain providing spectacular, sweeping views of the entire sprawling capital, accessible via a thrilling cable car or a steep pilgrimage hike.

landmarks.name: Gold Museum (Museo del Oro)
landmarks.description: One of the most fascinating museums in South America, displaying the largest collection of stunning pre-Hispanic gold artifacts in the world.

landmarks.name: Comuna 13
landmarks.description: A formerly dangerous neighborhood completely transformed by community spirit, incredible street art, and a massive set of outdoor public escalators.

landmarks.name: Plaza Botero
landmarks.description: An outdoor park in the city center showcasing 23 massive, delightfully exaggerated bronze sculptures donated by the famous Colombian artist Fernando Botero.

landmarks.name: The Walled City
landmarks.description: A remarkably romantic, UNESCO-listed historic center completely enclosed by old stone walls, featuring vibrant colonial buildings covered in cascading bougainvillea.

landmarks.name: Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas
landmarks.description: A massive, impregnable Spanish fortress built strategically on a hill, featuring a complex and fascinating network of underground defensive tunnels.

landmarks.name: Cristo Rey Monument
landmarks.description: A massive, 26-meter-tall statue of Christ with open arms standing on a high mountain, offering incredible panoramic views over the salsa capital of the world.

landmarks.name: San Antonio Neighborhood
landmarks.description: A highly charming, bohemian historical district known for its steep streets, colorful colonial architecture, artisan shops, and lively evening atmosphere.

landmarks.name: Tayrona National Park
landmarks.description: A breathtakingly beautiful protected area where the lush, dense jungle of the Sierra Nevada mountains rolls directly down to pristine Caribbean beaches.

landmarks.name: Ciudad Perdida (Lost City)
landmarks.description: An ancient, spectacular ruined city hidden deep in the jungle, older than Machu Picchu, accessible only via a challenging, multi-day tropical trek.

landmarks.name: San Cristobal Hill
landmarks.description: A prominent hill rising high above the capital, topped with a towering statue of the Virgin Mary and offering spectacular sunset views of the city and the Andes.

landmarks.name: Sky Costanera
landmarks.description: The highest observation deck in South America, located in a towering skyscraper and providing unparalleled 360-degree views of the sprawling metropolis.

landmarks.name: Historic Quarter
landmarks.description: A wildly colorful, bohemian port city built on steep hills, famous for its historic funicular elevators and incredible, vibrant street art blanketing the walls.

landmarks.name: La Sebastiana
landmarks.description: The incredibly quirky, ship-themed former home of the beloved Nobel Prize-winning poet Pablo Neruda, offering sweeping views of the bustling harbor below.

landmarks.name: Valle de la Luna
landmarks.description: A spectacular, otherworldly desert landscape featuring jagged stone formations, massive sand dunes, and an eerie, silent terrain that truly resembles the moon.

landmarks.name: El Tatio Geysers
landmarks.description: The highest geyser field in the world, best visited at freezing dawn to watch dozens of dramatic steam columns shooting high into the incredibly clear sky.

landmarks.name: Torres del Paine National Park
landmarks.description: A legendary, rugged wilderness at the southern tip of the world, famous for its massive glaciers, bright blue lakes, and iconic, jagged granite horn peaks.

landmarks.name: Magdalena Island
landmarks.description: A small, protected island located in the Strait of Magellan that serves as the bustling home to a massive, incredibly noisy colony of over 100,000 Magellanic penguins.

landmarks.name: Osorno Volcano
landmarks.description: A perfectly conical, highly photogenic snow-capped stratovolcano closely resembling Mount Fuji, dominating the skyline over the stunning Lake Llanquihue.

landmarks.name: Petrohué Waterfalls
landmarks.description: A spectacular series of roaring, chute-like waterfalls carving their way through highly unusual, black volcanic basalt rock formations.

landmarks.name: Sydney Opera House
landmarks.description: A globally recognized architectural masterpiece featuring iconic, sail-like white roofs, stunningly situated right on the edge of the vibrant Sydney Harbour.

landmarks.name: Bondi Beach
landmarks.description: One of the most famous beaches in the world, highly renowned for its golden crescent of sand, reliable surfing waves, and lively coastal cafe culture.

landmarks.name: Federation Square
landmarks.description: A highly modern, visually striking public square that serves as the cultural hub of the city, surrounded by fantastic museums, galleries, and excellent dining.

landmarks.name: Royal Botanic Gardens
landmarks.description: A spectacular, sprawling 38-hectare green oasis located near the city center, offering incredibly diverse plant life and beautifully tranquil lakes.

landmarks.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
landmarks.description: The world's oldest and largest koala sanctuary, offering visitors the highly memorable and unique opportunity to safely hold a koala and hand-feed kangaroos.

landmarks.name: South Bank Parklands
landmarks.description: A fantastic, vibrant riverside precinct featuring lush parklands, world-class restaurants, and Streets Beach—Australia's only man-made inner-city beach.

landmarks.name: Kings Park
landmarks.description: One of the largest and most beautiful inner-city parks in the world, offering sweeping views of the Swan River and a massive, spectacular botanical garden.

landmarks.name: Rottnest Island
landmarks.description: A stunning, car-free island paradise located just off the coast, globally famous for its pristine beaches and its population of incredibly photogenic, smiling quokkas.

landmarks.name: Surfers Paradise
landmarks.description: A highly energetic, iconic coastal strip renowned for its towering high-rises situated right on the beach, vibrant nightlife, and excellent surfing conditions.

landmarks.name: Springbrook National Park
landmarks.description: A breathtaking UNESCO World Heritage-listed rainforest offering spectacular waterfalls, ancient trees, and a fascinating cave illuminated by thousands of natural glow worms.
